title: Jamestown Campground

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our RV sites are all pull-thru and range from 60 feet long to 85 feet long. Please let us know if you need satellite accessibility. We offer full hook-ups that include clean, drinking water, sewer, 50amp, 30 amp and limited cable. We also offer water and electric hook-ups, and electric only hook-ups. We have a dump station which can be used for a small fee. There are no fire rings at the RV sites but you are welcome to use the fire rings at unoccupied tent sites. We offer two rustic cabins each with a queen bed and twin bunk beds, a small refrigerator, a ceiling fan, and a small wall heater. These are near the freeway side of the property.
